# Options (generated by `node tools/options.mjs` from CONFIG; don't edit by hand)


## Commands
- /help: How Reem works, and every command
- /name: Tell Reem your name: /name Sam
- /about: What Reem knows about you: /about <details>
- /auto: Draft your next message for you: /auto [idea]
- /retry: A new version of Reem's last reply
- /rewind: Reply to a message: erase everything after it
- /edit: Reply to her message: /edit <new text>
- /voice: Ask Reem to send voice notes more often (on/off)
- /memory: See what Reem remembers long-term
- /pics (also /selfie, /selfies): Ask Reem to send pictures more often (on/off)
- /look (also /see, /view): A picture of what you see right now (words after it steer it)
- /pic (also /photo, /custom): A picture of Reem as you describe it: /pic <hair, makeup, clothes, pose, framing, angle>
- /spend (also /cost, /costs): What Reem cost today, and what's left on each account
- /album (also /gallery): Every picture Reem has sent you, 10 at a time: /album [page]
- /face: Reem's face in her pictures: /face draws new ones to pick from
- /restart (also /start): Start the story over (wipes her memory)

## Shots (poses) she or /pic can pick
- **close**: Close-up of her face and shoulders.
- **selfie**: Chest-up.
- **mirror**: Full-body reflection in a mirror in {her bedroom|the hallway between their doors}, the room behind her, a little flash glare on the glass.
- **cozy**: Chest-up, curled up {on the sofa in her living room, wool socks, knees pulled up|under a blanket on the sofa in her living room|in bed against the pillows in her bedroom}.
- **detail**: Close-up of {her hand with thin gold rings around a coffee cup in her kitchen|her bare feet up on the railing of her back porch|her hand with a yellow highlighter on a stack of receipts by a printing calculator in her living room}, her face out of frame.
- **golden**: Chest-up on her back porch at golden hour, warm low sun on her face, maple trees and rooftops behind her.
- **mirror-back**: Back view: she stands with her back to a mirror in {her bedroom|the hallway between their doors} and twists to look over her shoulder at her phone; the reflection shows her back, 3/4 body.
- **neckline**: Taken from above, chest-up, her collarbones and neckline in the frame.
- **legs**: Taken from above while she sits {on the sofa in her living room|on the bed in her bedroom|on a chair on her back porch}, her legs crossed and in the frame.
- **waist**: 3/4-body reflection in a mirror in her bedroom, one hand on her waist, her hip turned toward the mirror.
- **belly-down**: Taken from above while she lies on her stomach {on the bed in her bedroom|on the sofa in her living room}, propped on her elbows, her feet up and crossed behind her.
- **overhead**: Taken from straight above while she lies on her back in bed in her bedroom, her hair spread over the pillow.
- **floor-sit**: Sitting on the floor of her living room with her back against the sofa, knees pulled up, a mug beside her.
- **counter-sit**: Sitting up on the counter in her kitchen, legs dangling, leaning back on one hand.
- **window-lean**: Leaning on the window frame {in her bedroom|in her living room}, half turned toward the glass.
- **stretch-mirror**: Full-body reflection in a mirror in {her bedroom|the hallway between their doors}, stretching one arm up over her head, her top riding up a little.
